## Description
Please include a concise summary of the change, motivation, and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to break)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance / Security improvement

## Validation & Testing
- [ ] Go formatting verified (`gofmt -s -w .`)
- [ ] Go static analysis passes with zero warnings (`go vet ./...`)
- [ ] All Go tests pass (`go test -v ./...`)
- [ ] All Python tests pass (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly
